name: I Tattoli Chianti Classico DOP EVOO, 500ml
tagline: Limited Edition! When it's gone, it's gone!
description:
Crafted under the strict regulations of Chianti Classico D.O.P., I Tattoli’s estate-grown extra virgin olive oil comes from olive groves that the Bini Smaghi family has tended since 1428. I Tattoli—the family’s historic estate in the heart of the iconic Chianti Classico region—is where Cristina Bini Smaghi took up and improved a centuries-old tradition, reinvigorating olive oil production with innovation, sustainability, and a fiercely uncompromising commitment to quality.

The 2024 edition of this oil is a medium-intensity blend of Leccio del Corno, Frantoio, Moraiolo, and Pendolino olives. Opening with the vibrant aroma of misticanza (mixed wild chicories and fresh herbs), this well-balanced oil reveals layers of complex flavor on the palate—green almond, crisp green apple, thistle, and pine nut. I Tattoli’s aroma and flavor will enhance any dish with sparkling green notes.

subtype: 올리오 누오보/새 수확 (Olio Nuovo / New Harvest)
name: Poggio la Noce 2025 EVOO, 500ml
tagline: New Harvest 2025! This was an olive a few short weeks ago!
description: It's here... the 2025 Harvest!! We look forward to this oil coming out every fall - it is truly an amazing representation of true Tuscan olive oil. With hints of freshly cut grass, almonds & artichokes, it's not just one of our favorite oils, it happens to be produced by a couple of our favorite people - husband and wife team, Enzo Schiano and Claire Beliard. The olives from their 1,500 tree grove are hand-picked and pressed on the estate the same day. This helps to preserve all the intense flavor and fragrance of the olives and ensures the lowest grade of acidity possible. This oil was in it's olive state just a few short weeks ago, and in a few more short weeks, it will be gone...get it while you can, when it's gone, it's gone!

name: The DeLaurenti Grocery Top 20 - ALL 20!
tagline: 20 Hand-picked grocery favorites by Nate & Matt - DeLaurenti Owners - SHIPS ANYWHERE!
description:
There are 2 guarentees with making a list of our Top 20 grocery products when we have 5000. 1st, the 20 that are on the list will be really, really good. 2nd, there we be thousands of other great products left off the list.

This list was compiled by owners Nate & Matt - 10 each. The criteria: you have to love it and you have to choose in 15 minutes. The list checks all the boxes - savory, salty, sweet, crunchy & spicy. Here's what you get:

Ayoh Giardiniera, Villa Manodori Balsamic, Confectionally Yours Toffee, Lunardi Lemon Cantucci, Spinaker 70% Madagascar Sea Salt, Danieli Traditional Tarallini, Bachan’s Gluten Free Japanese BBQ Sauce, Nunez de Prado EVOO, Scalia Anchovies, Maldon Salt, Bret’s Chips (asst flavors), Uncle Jerry’s Extra Dark Pretzels, Mitika OnionToketti, Suhey Peppers, Stuzzi Hot Sauce, Graham’s Horseradish Sauce, Monte’s Tomato Sauce, Drifter’s Fish Smoked Salmon, Oro Liquido Marcona Almond Butter & Tirrena Spaghetti.

name: Museum DOP Garda Orientale EVOO, 500ml
description:
Discover the exquisite taste of Flavio Turri's DOP Extra Virgin Olive Oil, a true gem from the enchanting region surrounding Lake Garda. As a third-generation producer, Flavio carries on a family legacy that began in the 1900s, crafting olive oil with passion and expertise. His family's journey from a Venetian villa to the picturesque village of Cisano di Bardolino has enriched their offerings, showcasing the unique DOPs of the area. At their tasting facility, both locals and tourists can immerse themselves in the rich culture and traditions of quality extra virgin olive oil, making every visit a delightful experience.

This beautifully balanced Garda DOP olive oil, primarily made from the renowned Casaliva olives, captures the essence of northern Italy's culinary renaissance. Perfect for drizzling over salads, enhancing fish dishes, or elevating vegetables, each drop evokes memories of sun-kissed days by the lake, surrounded by the region's traditional foods and wines. Indulge in this liquid gold and let it transport you to the shores of the Lago di Garda!

name: Decimi "No. 51" Limited Edition Umbria Moraiolo EVOO, 500ml
description:
From the region of Umbria in central Italy, this vibrant green extra virgin olive oil is made with 80% Moraiolo & 20% ancient Umbrian varietals. It has elegant aromas of fresh vegetables, and cut grass. Very balanced on the palate it has a lasting finish of almonds and green peppercorn.

If that wasn't enough, it also has the distinction of being a Slow Food Presidio oil. This means that Decimi is a small-scale food producer that protects traditional and artisanal products that are at risk of disappearing. Presidia producers follow the principles of agroecology, respecting the soil, water, animal welfare, and biodiversity. They use time-honored methods and avoid the use of pesticides, antibiotics, preservatives, artificial additives, and dyes. Choosing this oil helps support this producer's commitment to these important, time honored practices!

name: Nativ Piume Campania 100% Ravece EVOO, 500ml
description: Roberta Pirone and Mario Ercolino, a renowned enologist, founded Nativ winery in 2008 with an emphasis on the terroir of the area. Their vineyards and olive groves are located in Paternopoli, in the province of Avellino, central Campania. Their olive oil is made with indigenous olive varieties Olivella di Carife and Ravece, typical to Campania. This 100% Ravece oil is bright yellow green in color with aromas of green tomato, artichoke & thistle.

name: Nativ Piume Campania Blend EVOO, 500ml
description: Roberta Pirone and Mario Ercolino, a renowned enologist, founded Nativ winery in 2008 with an emphasis on the terroir of the area. Their vineyards and olive groves are located in Paternopoli, in the province of Avellino, central Campania. Their olive oil is made with indigenous olive varieties typical to Campania. This oil is a blend of three such varieties: Ogliarola, Peranzana & Ravece. It is deep yellow with a hint of green in color with an intensely fruity aroma, complimented by a delicate balance of bitterness and subtle spice.

name: Accademia Olearia Giuseppe Fois Gran Riserva Sardinian EVOO
description: Like many others on our shelves, this lovely olive oil is brought to us by the folks at Ritrovo Imports, the source of the some of the finest food that DeLaurenti is proud to sell. Boldly aromatic and green, this Sardinian Olive Oil is pressed from 100% Bosana olives immediately after harvest with a top-of-the-line cold extraction system. Jewel green in color, it is clean on the palate with green tomato and apple notes with a spicy, bitter finish. Perfect for your best salad dressing & finishing pasta & grilled meats.

name: DeLaurenti Lazio Riserva EVOO, 500ml
description: This house olive oil is from the Colli Etruschi, a farm cooperative located near the Etruscan town of Blera in the province of Lazio. Made from late-harvest Caninese olives, it is silky and bold with a peppery finish. With aromas of fresh cut grass and lime, it is perfect for cooking, salad dressings or finishing grilled vegetables.

name: DeLaurenti Puglia Riserva EVOO, 500ml
description: From the heel of the boot, our Puglia Riserva is a versatile, rich and superbly blended olive oil made from hand-harvested Coratina, Frantoio, Leccino and Ogliarola olives. Full flavored and fruity with a hint of pepper on the finish, this oil's beautiful ceramic tile label also makes it a memorable gift.

name: Colli Etruschi Roma IGP EVOO, 500ml
description: Colli Etruschi is a farm cooperative located near the Etruscan town of Blera. Under the strict supervision of agronomist Nicola Fazzi, their facility uses state-of-the-equipment to produce the highest quality extra virgin olive oils. This oil is harvested from 50-year-old olive trees with 8 hours of picking to pressing process. A combination of caninese, leccino and frantoio olives, it is a vibrant green color and fruity with aromas of green fruit, leaves, cardoon, and artichoke. On the palate, this oil has hints of aromatic herbs, and a warm spicey finish.

name: Olive Truck Tuscan EVOO, 500ml
description:
Some of the world's best olives for making oil are grown in the most remote regions. If you can't bring the olives to the mill, then bring the mill to the olives! Olive Truck founder Sam & his state-of-the-art mobile mill truck follows the harvest, pressing olives within hours of picking - ensuring the preservation of their delicate aromas, flavors, and healthful compounds. The result: oils with remarkably low acidity, soaring polyphenol content, and most importantly, bold and complex flavor profiles that speak for themselves.

His Tuscan Blend features Frantoio, Leccino & Pendolino olives grown in Petaluma, Sonoma County, California. This award winning oil is medium intensity with notes of green apple, artichoke & eucalyptus.

name: Tenuta Sant' Ilario Pietra EVOO, 50ml
description: The Tenuta Sant'Ilario Estate in Abruzzo produces amazing olive oil. This bold and flavorful olive oil from the province of Teramo in Abruzzo. is harvested from olives grown 1,200 meters above sea level. This oil boasts a unique blend of 60% Rustichella dell'Aquila, 30% Leccino, and 10% Gentile dell'Aquila.

name: Tenuta Sant'Ilario Argilla EVOO, 500ml
description: The Tenuta Sant'Ilario Estate in Abruzzo produces amazing olive oil. This one, harvested in the hilly zone of Atri, above the sea town of Pineto, is made with 30% Dritto, 30% Leccino del Corno, 30% Frantoio & 10% Tortiglione olives. It has a feint, pleasant bitterness with tons of fruit.

name: Tenuta Sant'ilario Pineto Arte in Cucina, 6 X 20ml Tubes
tagline: Extra Virgin Olive Oil Tasting Set from Italy's Abruzzo Region
description: This Olive Oil tasting set from Tenuta Sant'Ilario in Abruzzo is the perfect gift for the person who loves olive oil. A fun way to taste 6 different Olive Varietals and decide which one is your fav. Argilla, Terra, Sabbia, Tortiglione, Intosso and Dritta, in acrylic style paint tubes!

name: Tenuta Sant'Ilario Sabbia EVOO, 500ml
description: The Tenuta Sant'Ilario Estate in Abruzzo produces amazing olive oil. This one, harvested near the seaside in the province of Teramo is made with 40% Leccino, 30% Frantoio, 20% Cucco & 10% olives. This oil has bitter tones, with a slight spiciness.

name: Tenuta Sant'Ilario Terra EVOO, 500ml
description: The Tenuta Sant'Ilario Estate in Abruzzo produces amazing olive oil. This award winning oil is made from olives cultivated at the foot of the Abruzzo mountains, 900 meters above sea level. Balanced with light bitter and spicy notes, it is made with 40% Intosso, 30% Dritta, 20% Tortiglione & 10% Cucco olives.

name: Erik Banti Olive Oil, 1L
description: Erik Banti is as good at making olive oil as he is at making wine. This oil comes from the same vineyards in the heart of the Morellino di Scansano DOCG and Maremma Toscana DOC appelations. Made with mostly frantoio and leccino varieties with some moraiolo and caninese, all the olives are picked by hand and cold pressed within hours of separation from the trees. Low in acidity, it has a leaf-like color with an intense aroma and piquant flavor with hints of raw artichokes. Perfect for drizzling on grilled meats, vegetables and foccaccia!

name: Frescobaldi Laudemio EVOO, 500ml
description: In medieval times the term laudemio indicated the part of the harvest reserved for the feudal lord. As the best part of the harvest, these oils were only offered to noblemen. Today Laudemio is the name of the consortium that was created in 1986 to attain the highest quality oil with standards of production that exceed normal regulations. The result of all of this is an amazing olive oil. A Tuscan estate oil, it is made with olives harvested by hand and pressed the same day at the property's own mill. Intense and brilliant green in color, it has aromas of fresh cut grass and artichoke, with a classic peppery finish. Here's what you do: grill a bone-in rib eye steak. Let it rest, slice it and fan over a bed of arugula. Sprinkle with sea salt, a squeeze of lemon and a drizzle of Laudemio Frescobaldi. Enjoy with a Tuscan red.

name: Madonna Dell'Olivo Itran's, 500ml
description: The limited edition, mono-varietal EVOO is made with 100% Itran olives in Italy's Campania region. It is golden green in color with an elegant, grassy aroma. More peppery than bitter in flavor, it has a light, citrus finish. With incredibly low acidity and high antioxident levels it is an elegant and versatile oil, best for unripened cheeses, summer vegetables and salads.

name: Madonna Dell'Olivo Raro, 500ml
description: This limited production olive oil from Italy's Campania region is made from Ravece and Rotondella olives. It has a light pea-vine color with full flavor and a big peppery finish. Low in acidity, it's subtle bitterness will bring out the true flavors of your bean dishes, steak, soups and bitter greens.

name: Madonna Dell'Olivo Rotondella EVOO, 250ml
description: This limited production olive oil from Italy's Campania region is made with 100% Rotondella olives. It is robust, intense, and fruity. It has aromas of green almond, raw artichoke, chicory, and a slight hint of wasabi with a nice long finish. It will add character to steaks, soups, grilled veggies, bruschetta, risotto, or pasta.

name: Nicolas Alziari Cuvee Prestige EVOO, 1L
description: An exceptional house born in 1868, Nicolas Alziari produces great vintages of olive oils, oils from Nice PDO and oils grown in organic farming. Their Cuvee Prestige oil has a uniquely fruity flavor profile with a distinctively sweet aroma. Hints of mango, artichokes & hazelnuts make it ideal for raw vegetables, fish and poultry.

name: Nicolas Alziari Cuvee Prestige EVOO, 250ml
description: An exceptional house born in 1868, Nicolas Alziari produces great vintages of olive oils, oils from Nice PDO and oils grown in organic farming. Their Cuvee Prestige oil has a uniquely fruity flavor profile with a distinctively sweet aroma. Hints of mango, artichokes & hazelnuts make it ideal for raw vegetables, fish and poultry.

name: Nicolas Alziari Cuvee Prestige EVOO, 500ml
description: An exceptional house born in 1868, Nicolas Alziari produces great vintages of olive oils, oils from Nice PDO and oils grown in organic farming. Their Cuvee Prestige oil has a uniquely fruity flavor profile with a distinctively sweet aroma. Hints of mango, artichokes & hazelnuts make it ideal for raw vegetables, fish and poultry.

name: Azeite Esplendido, Portuguese, EVOO
description: Among the best olive oils Portugal has to offer, Azeite Esplêndido is well-balanced with a maximum acidity of just 0.2% and polyphenol rich. It is prized for its golden-green hue, vibrant aroma, and complex flavor profile featuring fruity, grassy notes, a bold spiciness, and a smooth, peppery finish. Perfect for vinaigrettes, dipping crusty bread, or drizzling over grilled meats, bean dishes, and crisp-tender vegetables.

name: Iliada EVOO, 3L
description: Made with Koroneiki olives grown in the Kalamata region of the Peloponnese, this is your workhorse Greek olive oil. Fragrant, fruity, but mild - it's versatility makes it perfect for everything from sauteing to dipping. Don't tell us 3L is too much. Just convert your favorite empty wine bottle into your next olive oil dispenser with a quick rinse and a pouring spout. Keep the tin in the cupboard away from light and heat, and have the bottle at the ready on your kitchen counter. Use liberally and refill!

name: Iliada Organic EVOO, 500ml
description: Made with Koroneiki olives grown in the Kalamata region of the Peloponnese, this is your workhorse orgainic Greek olive oil. Fragrant, fruity, but mild - it's versatility makes it perfect for everything from sauteing to dipping! Once size can fit all!

name: Iliada Single Estate EVOO, 750ml
description: Iliada Single Estate is a limited production Extra Virgin Olive Oil originating from a single olive farm. Single Estate olive oil is considered among the very best olive oils due to the unique characteristics influenced by natural factors such as the local soil, altitude, microclimate and olive fruit variety. Deep golden green in color, it has an aroma of freshly cut grass with distinct notes of herbs, artichoke and red apple and a peppery finish.

name: Merlino Tonda Iblea EVOO, 750ml
description: Imported by our friends at Merlino Foods and produced by Frantoi Cultera in Sicily, this oil is made with 100% Tonda Iblea olives. Rich & fruity, it has a fresh aroma with a warm, spicy finish. Great flavor, great oil and a great price for 750ml of estate produced extra virgin olive oil!

name: Regalis Hojiblanca EVOO,
description: Harvested in early November in Andalucia, Spain, this all-purpose DOP certified Hojiblanca olive oil has flavors of mellow green apple and caramelized banana. With zero astringency, low acidity (.16%), and a fantastic mouthfeel, it is great for cooking, sautéing, frying, and finishing.

name: Travignoli EVOO, 1L
description: Known for their exceptional Tuscan wines, it makes sense that the Travignoli estate would also produce exceptional olive oil. If you made that assumption, you'd be correct. This is a classic Tuscan oil - pleasantly bitter with a touch of fruit & a warm spicey finish. Lace your September heirloom tomatoes, make salad dressing & finish your Bistecca alla Fiorentina!

name: Frantoia Barbera EVOO, 1L
description: A DeLaurenti customer favorite for years, this Sicilian unfiltered olive oil is skillfully blended by Manfredi Barbera. The unique olive medley (Biancolilla, Cerasuola & Nocellara del Belice) yields an oil with balanced complexity. Frantoia is fruity and mild on the palate, with a subtle peppery finish. Great for salad dressing, dipping and finishing.

name: Frantoia Barbera EVOO, 500ml
description: A DeLaurenti customer favorite for years, this Sicilian unfiltered olive oil is skillfully blended by Manfredi Barbera. The unique olive medley (Biancolilla, Cerasuola & Nocellara del Belice) yields an oil with balanced complexity. Frantoia is fruity and mild on the palate, with a subtle peppery finish. Great for salad dressing, dipping and finishing.

name: Gambuzza Organic Sesame Oil, 250ml
description:
The Organic Sesame of Ispica is rooted in the landscape of Sicily where it is exposed to the radiant glow of the sun, specifically from the charming village of Ragusa. This exceptional sesame is cultivated with a deep respect for tradition and nature, reflecting a family legacy that dates back to the 1960s. Guided by the expertise of generations, it is produced adhering to organic farming practices and without pesticides. The result is an amazing product that is not only gluten-free but also rich in essential nutrients such as iron, magnesium, and calcium. Recognized as a Slow Food Presidium since 2016, Gambuzza sesame stands out for its distinctive amber color and unique flavor, making it a staple in both vegetarian and vegan cuisines.

Cold-pressed from 100% organic sesame seeds, this oil boasts a high unsaturated fat content, making it a heart-healthy choice. It's the perfect choice for drizzling over salads or enhancing your favorite dishes.

name: Olio Verde EVOO, 500ml
description: Made from 100% Nocellara del Belice olives, it is one of the best olives oils you will ever taste. Year after year, this oil continues to be the first choice for chefs and home cooks alike. With a striking green color, Olio Verde has aromas of tomato leaf and fresh cut grass with a peppery finish. Use it for finishing grilled fish, meats, and vegetables, or for a simple vinaigrette with fresh squeezed lemon!

name: Algae Cooking Club Gochugaru Chili Oil, 7oz
tagline: Better for cooking, better for the planet & better for you!
description: Crafted with Chef Daniel Humm of Eleven Madison Park, this flavored oil infuses culinary algae oil with Korean Gochugaru chili and aromatic spices. It is rich in gut and heart friendly Omega-9, buttery-smooth, and perfectly balanced. It has a mild chili heat with warm spices like cinnamon & star anise. Steeped slowly with whole spices like tea in buttery algae oil, it will elevate your eggs, noodles, soups, stir fry or pizza!

name: Algae Cooking Club Oil, 16oz
tagline: Better for cooking, better for the planet & better for you!
description: Algae Oil? Wait..what? Question: What's wrong with producing high-quality fats, proteins, and nutrients in a matter of days with a fraction of the land, water, and carbon needed, without sacrificing flavor and quality? Answer: nothing. Enter our friend Algae! Turns out it yields a better everyday culinary oil for your gut & heart with tons of flavor! But why stop there? With more Omega-9s than any other oil, algae supports digestion, heart health, and high-heat cooking up to 535°F. It is neutral, buttery, and made to make you feel good. Perfect for frying, baking and achieving the perfect crust on your favorite piece of protein!

name: Algae Cooking Club Shiitake Oil, 7oz
tagline: Better for cooking, better for the planet & better for you!
description: Intentionally crafted with Eleven Madison Park, this umami-packed mushroom oil is the secret to enhancing flavors. Made with only premium spices and 100% high oleic algae oil. It's savory umami. Shiitake, miso, and black garlic bring rich, umami-packed flavor to all your dishes. It is high in Omega-3's, low in saturated fat and no artificial flavors, making it the perfect option for drizzling into ramen, swirling into pasta & finishing roasted vegetables!

name: Badia a Coltibuono EVOO, 250ml
description: Badia A Coltibuono is widely considered to be one of the highest quality and most consistent extra virgin olive oils in Italy. This classic Tuscan extra virgin olive oil has been produced since 1058! It is golden in color, with a bold, nutty and fruity flavor. The distinct peppery sensation produced at the back of your throat is the result of the olives that are harvested when they are young and fresh. This oil is perfect for salads, dipping bread, and finishing vegetables, steak, pasta, and soup.

description: Badia A Coltibuono is widely considered to be one of the highest quality and most consistent extra virgin olive oils in Italy. This classic Tuscan extra virgin olive oil has been produced since 1058! It is golden in color, with a bold, nutty and fruity flavor. The distinct peppery sensation produced at the back of your throat is the result of the olives that are harvested when they are young and fresh. This oil is perfect for salads, dipping bread, and finishing vegetables, steak, pasta, and soup.

name: Castelas EVOO Noir d'Olive, 500ml
description: Domaine Castelas started making olive oil in the heart of the Provence in 1997. Although not the oldest, they have been recognized as one of the finest producers in the area. Their award-winning Noir d'Olive oil begins with fully ripe olives that are picked, stored, and gently fermented before pressing. The result is a unique flavor that is akin to a French oil cured olive. It has a subtly fermented note, with hints of black tapenade, cocoa and vanilla, with truffley finish. It is perfect for garlic-seasoned salads, for making mayonnaise, and for drizzling on confits, mushrooms, and mashed potatoes.

name: Castelas EVOO, 500ml
description: Domaine Castelas started making olive oil in the heart of the Provence in 1997. Although not the oldest, they have been recognized as one of the finest producers in the area. This award-winning extra virgin olive oil is bursting with scents of raw artichokes, almonds and apples. It has a silky texture with subtle peppery finish. Perfect for salads, and finishing grilled vegetables and fish.

name: Partanna EVOO, 1L
description: This is one of our favorite multi-use extra virgin olive oils. Produced by the Asaro family in Partanna, Sicily since 1916, it is harvested every year in mid-October. It is cloudy, green and herbaceous, with a hint of pleasant spice. It's priced right for using in bulk, but has enough character for salads and finishing.

name: Partanna EVOO, 3L
description: This is one of our favorite multi-use extra virgin olive oils. Produced by the Asaro family in Partanna, Sicily since 1916, it is harvested every year in mid-October. It is cloudy, green and herbaceous, with a hint of pleasant spice. It's priced right for using in bulk, but has enough character for salads and finishing.

name: Partanna EVOO, 500ml
description: This is one of our favorite multi-use extra virgin olive oils. Produced by the Asaro family in Partanna, Sicily since 1916, it is harvested every year in mid-October. It is cloudy, green and herbaceous, with a hint of pleasant spice. It's priced right for using in bulk, but has enough character for salads and finishing.

name: Agrumato Lemon Infused EVOO, 200ml
description: From the Abruzzo region of Italy near the Adriatic sea, this unique condiment is made by crushing whole lemons with olives during olive oil production. This process captures the essential oils and juice of the fruit in the resulting extra virgin olive oil. It's perfect for drizzling on fresh cheeses like burrata, ricotta or chevre. Also fantastic with fresh pasta and grilled seafood of all kinds.

name: Agumato Citron Infused EVOO, 200ml
description:
The citron, or cedro in Italian, is an unusual citrus fruit, having a distinctive gnarly skin and pulpy interior. There is little use for the interior of the citron, which produces minimal juice, but the thick skin is intensely fragrant thanks to the essential oils in its outermost layer, and produces bright concentrated flavors. The color of citron can vary from lime green to yellow-orange, depending on the variety.

Agrumato Citron captures the aromatic flavor of Italian citrons through its unique whole-fruit crushing process. Whole citrons are crushed together with olives in a state-of-the-art frantoio, sealing the essential oils of the citron zest in the resulting extra virgin olive oil. Use Agrumato Citron as a seasoning for white fish, scallops, and chicken. It's also wonderful drizzled over steamed or raw vegetables.

name: Atlas Desert Miracle Organic EVOO, 500ml
description:
Desert Miracle Extra Virgin Olive Oil, by Atlas, originates from the rugged and arid ElBorouj region of Morocco. This oil embodies the resilience and character of olives cultivated in a challenging desert environment, produced by a family-run business spanning four generations.

This extraordinary olive oil is made from olives grown on a rocky phosphate plateau in Morocco's ElBorouj region, located about 93 miles from Casablanca, heading toward Marrakech. The oil features a blend of two olive varieties: Dahbia, a native Moroccan olive, and Arbequina, a Spanish variety. This unique combination, paired with its distinct origin, lends the oil its exceptional qualities.

name: Atlas Organic EVOO, 750ml
description: Atlas Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil is painstakingly produced by hand at the estate of El-Borouj in the middle of the rocky dessert 150 kilometers from Casablanca toward Marrakech in Morocco. Four generations of the Aqallal family have tended the land and continued the tradition of producing the highest quality olive oil that Morocco has to offer. A unique blend of Moroccan Picholine, Dahbia & Arbequina olives, it has the aroma of ripe bananas, red apples & tomatoes. Perfect as a finishing oil for grilled meats & vegetables, or to enjoy simply with a crusty baguette.

name: Nunez de Prado Organic EVOO, 1L
description: For seven generations, the Nuñez de Prado family has been producing amazing olive oil in the hills of Baena, Spain. 100% organic olives are handpicked and crushed in the family’s granite stone wheels, similar to those used by the Romans 20 centuries ago. Estate-produced and bottled, it is a blend of 14 different olive varieties. The oil has nuances of green olives, oranges, lemons, fresh cut grass, almonds, and apples - all accentuated by a smooth, sweet finish. An unfiltered oil with an even lower oleic acidity than 'extra virgin', it takes 11 kilos of olives to make 1 liter of this olive oil!

name: Nunez de Prado Organic EVOO, 500ml
description:
Nunez de Prado Flor de Aceite (also known as 'Flower of the Oil') is a 100% organic extra virgin olive oil harvested from a single estate in Spain that has been producing since 1795.

This oil is is gathered after the olives are crushed, but before they are pressed between mats. Only the oil that flows through with gravity is bottled in its unfiltered form. This oil has an extraordinary low oleic acidity of 0.1%, ten times lower than required to be labeled Extra Virgin.The result is a beautifully aromatic, fruity & unfiltered olive oil. It takes 11 kilos of olives to make 1 liter of this olive oil!

name: Neus Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 350ml
description: This premium olive oil is produced by Priorat Natur, a small company in Northern Spain that specializes in agricultural products made with traditional methods and recipes of the Priorat region, a rugged, hilly landscape dotted with ancient olive groves. Their Neus Extra Virgin Olive Oil (named after the founder’s grandmother, Neus de Mas Callot) is made exclusively with Arbequina olives, handpicked while green, cold pressed, and bottled immediately. The result is an award-winning oil, golden in color, rich and buttery up front, with a gentle bite in the elegant finish. Use for dipping with crusty bread or drizzled over poultry and fish dishes.

name: Villa Manodori EVOO w/Black Pepper, 250ml

name: Villa Jerada Moroccan Extra Virgin Olive Oil, 500ml
description:
Villa Jerada's Extra Virgin Olive Oil is made from Moroccan Picholine olives grown on a single estate in the foothills of the Atlas Mountains.

They created this oil to mark Villa Jerada's 15th anniversary and to share something they've been searching for throughout their years of working with Moroccan producers: an exceptional olive oil that reflects the place, the people and the agricultural traditions they know and love.

The olives are hand-harvested from a farm certified for organic production and pressed in small batches to preserve their fresh, vibrant character. The farm also follows regenerative agricultural practices.

The result is an intensely fruity, green olive oil with fresh herbaceous notes, depth on the palate and a distinctly peppery finish. Moroccan Picholine is prized for its bright fruitiness and naturally high polyphenol content.

This is an oil for everyday use, not one to save for special occasions. Pour it over tomatoes, grilled vegetables, fish, eggs and salads. Dip warm bread into it. Finish a tagine, soup or grain bowl. Or simply taste it on its own.

From the olive groves of Morocco to your kitchen.
